newsitem.title: USA: Funco to open 40 stores in next 12 months.
newsitem.headline: Funco to open 40 stores in next 12 months.

text.p: Funco Inc, which buys and resells new and used video games, related hardware and accessories, on Tuesday said it intended to open about 40 stores during the next 12 months.
Funco said it was accelerating its store growth based on improved operating results and a favorable outlook for the video game industry.
As of December 29, Funco operated 188 stores, compared with 182 stores on December 31, 1995.

Earlier Tuesday, Funco said sales for its fiscal 1997 third quarter ended December 31 rose 46 percent to $46.5 million. The company's earnings rose to $3 million, or $0.48 a share, from $870,000, or $0.15, in the same period the previous year. Comparable store sales for the quarter increased 41 percent, Funco said in a statement.

Funco attributed the sales increase to a revitalization of the video game category, primarily because of the introduction and growing market penetration of Sony PlayStation, Nintendo 64 and Sega Saturn products.
Shares of Funco closed up 1/2 at 11-3/8 in Nasdaq trading.
